title: Programmer Analyst Trainee
description: Built a Python & PySpark scanning tool that sampled and processed 100M+ MS SQL records for enterprise-scale Master Data Management (MDM) cataloging. Integrated GPT-4o mini and text-embedding-3-large via direct OpenAI API to auto-generate data dictionaries with structured JSON output schemas. Developed a scalable FastAPI backend on Azure PostgreSQL serving 500+ concurrent catalog read requests with <200ms p95 latency. Evaluated retrieval quality using ragas; improved answer relevance from 0.62 to 0.84. Implemented LangSmith tracing for hallucination detection, reducing false-positive tagging by 18%.
